title.zh: Comino H200 供貨狀態：目前無貨，補貨時間未定
title.en: Comino H200 supply status: unavailable; no restock ETA

summary.zh: Comino H200 目前無貨，補貨時間未定；配置僅供規格評估與供貨查詢。
summary.en: Comino H200 is currently unavailable with no restock ETA. Configurations are for specification review and supply enquiries only.

detail.zh: 依 Comino 2026-10-08 供貨回覆，目前沒有 H200 GPU，亦無法預估恢復供應時間。本站 H200 規格、文件與配置入口僅供技術評估及需求登記，不代表現貨、可接單或確定交期。供貨恢復、可報價配置及交付時程，須另經原廠與 EudTech 書面確認。
detail.en: According to Comino’s supply update dated 2026-10-08, H200 GPUs are unavailable and there is no forecast for availability. H200 specifications, documents and configurator entries on this site are for technical evaluation and recording requirements only; they do not indicate stock, order acceptance or a confirmed delivery date. Resumed supply, quotable configurations and delivery schedules require separate written confirmation from Comino and EudTech.

question.zh: Comino H200 有現貨或確定交期嗎？
question.en: Is Comino H200 in stock or available with a confirmed delivery date?
